The '''''Peregrine''-class star yacht''' was a model of luxurious [[Yacht/Legends|star yacht]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] owned one such vessel, the [[Thief's Eye/Legends|''Thief's Eye'']].
